description: Print the current page to a PDF file using print CSS. Returns the saved file path.

background.description: Print background colors and images (default: false)

saveTo.description: Where to save the PDF. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true or omit it (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

name: print_page
